title: KBSpec: LLM-driven Formal Specification Generation with Evolving Domain Knowledge Base
abstract: arXiv:2606.21339v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated formal specification generation is a key step towards program understanding and formal verification. Recently, due to the success of large language models (LLMs) in code generation, researchers have made early attempts to adopt LLMs for generating formal specifications. However, the lack of formal specification language corpora in the wild often makes LLMs fail to generate syntactically correct and semantically verifiable specifications. To mitigate this gap, we propose KBSpec, which augments LLMs with dual-source knowledge of formal specification languages: external knowledge from official documentation, and internal knowledge distilled from verifier feedback on LLM-generated specifications. KBSpec maintains a self-evolving knowledge base that is continuously updated from successful generation and repair trajectories, without any LLM parameter tuning or labeled training data. translated_title: KBSpec：基于演进领域知识库的LLM驱动形式化规范生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.21339v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：自动生成形式化规范是程序理解和形式化验证的关键步骤。近年来，由于大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成方面的成功，研究人员已初步尝试采用LLMs生成形式化规范。然而，野外缺乏形式化规范语言语料库，常常导致LLMs无法生成语法正确且语义可验证的规范。为弥补这一差距，我们提出KBSpec，它通过双源知识增强LLMs对形式化规范语言的理解：来自官方文档的外部知识，以及从验证器对LLM生成规范的反馈中提取的内部知识。KBSpec维护一个自我演进的知识库，该知识库从成功的生成和修复轨迹中持续更新，无需任何LLM参数调整或标记训练数据。我们在Java建模语言（JML）上评估了KBSpec。
tldr: KBSpec通过构建自我演进的双源知识库（官方文档和验证器反馈），无需参数调整或标注数据，显著提升了LLM生成形式化规范的语法正确性和语义可验证性。
en_tdlr: KBSpec enhances LLM-based formal specification generation by maintaining a self-evolving dual-source knowledge base from official docs and verifier feedback, achieving syntactic correctness and semantic verifiability without parameter tuning or labeled data.
